26:112.text: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?

26:113.text: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you

26:114.text: And I am not one to drive away the believers.

26:115.text: I am only a clear warner."

26:116.text: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."

26:117.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.

26:118.text: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."

26:119.text: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

26:120.text: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.

26:121.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

26:122.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

26:124.text: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

26:125.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

26:126.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

26:127.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

26:130.text: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.

26:131.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

26:135.text: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
